Samarkand, Uzbekistan — the city of Amir Timur (Tamerlane), a ruler remembered in India for the devastating invasion of Delhi in 1398, but celebrated as a national hero in Uzbekistan.
Why is Timur remembered so differently in these two countries? And what is the mystery behind his tomb?
In this Uzbekistan travel vlog in Hindi, we travel from Tashkent to Samarkand on the Afrosiyob high-speed train with our Travelling Mantra group tour.
